758:t_1:139.en:
$$ランカ$$
「$$アルト$$ is at it again... Is he flying around in his EX-Gear?」

758:t_1:140.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Yep. He did say he really loves the sky on this new planet.」

758:t_1:141.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「That guy... using the recon mission as an excuse to do whatever he wants.」

758:t_1:142.en:
$$クラン$$
「Oh, let him be. Today's mission is a survey in name only. It's basically a picnic.」

758:t_1:143.en:
$$カナリア$$
「That's right. That's why family members and lovers are allowed to come along.」

758:t_1:144.en:
$$ナナセ$$
「Thank you for inviting me too, $$ルカ$$.」

758:t_1:146.en:
$$ナナセ$$
「I'm so happy that I get to be with $$ランカ$$ even on my days off!」

758:t_1:148.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Still, Ensign $$アルト$$'s love of the sky is a bit abnormal once it goes that far.」

758:t_1:149.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Not really. Everyone feels the urge to fly an unknown sky as freely as they can.」

758:t_1:150.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That frontier spirit is what has kept us moving forward all this time.」

758:t_1:151.en:
$$キャシー$$
「...True. And thanks to that fearless spirit, we were even able to come to understand the $$バジュラ$$.」

758:t_1:152.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「However, as the deputy leader of $$スカル$$ Squadron, I can't overlook it any longer.」

758:t_1:153.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Watching $$アルト$$ has got you itching to fly too, hasn't it, $$ブレラ$$?」

758:t_1:155.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Go get him, my brother! Take $$アルト$$ down a peg, he's getting cocky!」

758:t_1:156.en:
$$オズマ$$
「The $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ returns to Earth tomorrow! Until then, enjoy our new homeland to the fullest!」

758:t_1:158.en:
$$アルト$$
「That $$ブレラ$$... The Captain told him to chase me down, huh...」

758:t_1:159.en:
$$アルト$$
「But don't think you can stop me now!」

758:t_1:161.en:
$$アルト$$
「A juvenile $$バジュラ$$...! Have you come back to the planet where you were born?」

758:t_1:162.en:
$$アルト$$
「Coexisting with the $$バジュラ$$... Looks like it'll happen sooner than I thought.」

758:t_1:163.en:
$$アルト$$
(I'll fly this sky... Bound by nothing, however I please...)

758:t_1:164.en:
$$アルト$$
(But I'm not alone... $$ランカ$$... I'll definitely come back to you.)

758:t_1:165.en:
$$アルト$$
「That $$ブレラ$$... The Captain told him to chase me down, huh...」

758:t_1:166.en:
$$アルト$$
「But don't think you can stop me now!」

758:t_1:168.en:
$$アルト$$
「A juvenile $$バジュラ$$...! Have you come back to the planet where you were born?」

758:t_1:169.en:
$$アルト$$
「Coexisting with the $$バジュラ$$... Looks like it'll happen sooner than I thought.」

758:t_1:170.en:
$$アルト$$
(I'll fly this sky... Bound by nothing, however I please...)

758:t_1:171.en:
$$アルト$$
(But I'm not alone... $$シェリル$$... I'll definitely come back to you.)

758:t_1:175.en:
$$田中司令$$
「...All right, everyone. Thank you for all your hard work up to today.」

758:t_1:178.en:
$$田中司令$$
「The contract has kept getting extended by default, but as of today, $$チームＤ$$ is officially disbanded.」

758:t_1:182.en:
$$田中司令$$
「We will pay each of you a bonus for completing your contracts, and provide as much support as possible for your return to civilian life.」

758:t_1:183.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Also, as a special exception, your memories will not be erased either! Oh, isn't that wonderful!」

758:t_1:185.en:
$$葵$$
「Would it be a bad idea to just keep $$チームＤ$$ going like this?」

758:t_1:186.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Even if you say that, the fighting is over now, and the role of $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$ is...」

758:t_1:188.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Have you forgotten $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$'s original purpose?」

758:t_1:189.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「Preserving the species and spreading it across the universe... that's the one.」

758:t_1:190.en:
$$田中司令$$
「But that's... just insurance in case Earth is destroyed...」

758:t_1:191.en:
$$葵$$
「That doesn't matter. Since we've got this amazing hyperdimensional world, don't you think traveling to all sorts of worlds isn't a bad idea?」

758:t_1:192.en:
$$くらら$$
「I think it'd be nice to go around the worlds everyone in $c comes from, or visit $$ＷＩＬＬ$$'s homeland, too.」

758:t_1:193.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「It's true that $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ was going to pass through the Gate and head for the universe where I was born, but...」

758:t_1:194.en:
$$ウラジミール$$
「You're telling me you plan to go along with that, too?」

758:t_1:196.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「In this new world, there aren't many ventures as rewarding as this one.」

758:t_1:197.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「Just thinking about it gets me excited.」

758:t_1:199.en:
$$葵$$
「I never go back on my word.」

758:t_1:200.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Then I will sign a new contract with $$チームＤ$$... And I hereby order you...」

758:t_1:201.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Spread your wings with $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$ in this new world!」

758:t_1:203.en:
$$葵$$
(Senpai, everyone... I know we'll meet again, right...)

758:t_1:208.en:
$$シリウス$$
「What I see over there is... the $$エレメントスクール$$...!」

758:t_1:209.en:
$$アポロ$$
「We... made it back to our original world...」

758:t_1:210.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Then we can see everyone again!」

758:t_1:211.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You look happy, $$シルヴィア$$.」

758:t_1:213.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「But the thing that made me happiest in that battle was getting to meet you, $$アポロ$$, and my brother.」

758:t_1:216.en:
$$シリウス$$
(Heh... My sister $$シルヴィア$$... You no longer need my help, do you...)

758:t_1:217.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Let's go, $$シルヴィア$$, $$シリウス$$. This is the world where we'll live!」

758:t_1:218.en:
$$アポロ$$
「And let's keep expanding it, faster and faster! So we can meet those guys again!」

758:t_1:219.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
(Across twelve thousand years, a world to live in with the one I love... So this is the place...)

758:t_1:225.en:
$$ドナール$$
「Good to see you made it back, you lot!」
